summary: 澳洲客轮永加拉号在 1911 年航行时遭遇气旋，此后失踪数十年。潜水者找到沉船后，一只保险柜的制造记录成为确认船只身份的关键。

paragraphs.role: 豪华蒸汽轮最后航行，SS Yongala
paragraphs.brief: 永加拉号最后一次启航
sentences: The SS Yongala is a passenger steam ship belonging to the Adelaide Steamship Company.
SS Yongala号是属于阿德莱德轮船公司的一艘客轮。
It cost the company $102,000 to build in 1903 and was named after the small town of Yongala in South Australia.
该公司于 1903 年耗资 10.2 万美元建造了它，并以南澳大利亚的小镇扬加拉为其命名。
Yongala means ‘good water’ in the Nadjuri language.
Yongala在Nadjuri语中的意思是“好水”。
On 23 March 1911, at 1.40 pm, the Yongala carried 49 passengers, 73 crew, and 617 tons of cargo and set sail for Townsville from Mackay under the command of Captain William Knight.
1911年3月23日下午1时40分，永加拉号在威廉·奈特船长指挥下，载着四十九名乘客、七十三名船员和六百一十七吨货物，从麦凯启航前往汤斯维尔。
paragraphs.gist: 阿德莱德轮船公司的「永加拉号」以南澳小镇命名，1911 年 3 月 23 日载着 49 名乘客、73 名船员和 617 吨货物从麦凯驶向汤斯维尔。

paragraphs.brief: 无无线电接收气旋警报
sentences: Shortly after leaving Mackay, the Flat Tap signal station received a telegram warning of a tropical cyclone between Townsville and Mackay.
永加拉号离开麦凯不久，Flat Tap 信号站便收到电报，警告汤斯维尔与麦凯之间出现热带气旋。
However, the SS Yongala was not fitted with any wireless equipment and could not be warned about the impending cyclone.
然而永加拉号没有配备无线电设备，因此无法收到即将遭遇气旋的警告。
On 26 March 1911, the SS Yongala was officially listed as missing, but search and rescue efforts to locate the ship proved to be unsuccessful.
1911年3月26日，永加拉号被正式列为失踪，随后的搜救行动没能找到这艘船。
paragraphs.gist: 船离开麦凯后，信号站才收到热带气旋警报，而船上没有无线电，无法接收警告；三天后它被列为失踪，搜救也未能找到。

paragraphs.brief: 海事调查因无目击者陷入僵局
sentences: There were many theories surrounding the disappearance of the Yongala, but the Marine Board of Queensland did not officially investigate its disappearance until 8 June 1911.
有许多关于Yongala失踪的理论，但昆士兰海洋委员会直到1911年6月8日才正式调查其失踪。
The investigation lasted 12 days and ended on 20 June 1911.
调查持续12天，于1911年6月20日结束。
Due to the lack of witnesses, the Marine Board of Queensland based their inquiry on the condition and seaworthiness of the ship as well as the skipper’s experience and abilities.
由于缺乏证人，昆士兰海洋局的调查依据是该船的状况和适航性以及船长的经验和能力。

It was determined that the SS Yongala was in good condition and the skipper was capable, and thus the Marine Board of Queensland concluded that “the fate of the Yongala passes beyond human ken into the realms of conjecture, to add one more to the mysteries of the sea”.
调查认定船况良好、船长胜任，因此昆士兰海事委员会只得作结：「永加拉号的命运已超出人所能知，只能凭推测，海上又添一桩谜案。」
paragraphs.gist: 昆士兰海事委员会因缺少目击者，只能查验船况和船长能力；两者都无明显问题，1911 年的调查只能留下悬案。

paragraphs.brief: 发现沉船与装满黑泥的保险柜
sentences: The mystery of the SS Yongala’s disappearance remained until 1958 when Bill Kirkpatrick located the wreck.
直到1958年比尔·柯克帕特里克找到残骸之后，SS Yongala失踪的奥秘一直存在
He then took members from the Queensland Underwater Research Group of Townsville on an expedition.
此后他带领汤斯维尔的昆士兰水下研究小组成员前去考察。
The group brought a barnacle-encrusted steel safe to the surface, hoping that it might contain important documents that would lead to the identification of the ship.
小组将一只长满藤壶的钢制保险柜打捞上来，希望里面有重要文件能确认船的身份。
However, when they cracked open the safe all they found was black sludge.
然而，当他们破解保险箱时，他们发现只有黑污泥。
The group had a hunch that the wreck was that of the SS Yongala, but had no definitive proof to back up their claims.
他们直觉认为这就是永加拉号，却拿不出确凿证据。
paragraphs.gist: 1958 年柯克帕特里克找到一处残骸，潜水队打捞出长满藤壶的保险柜，却只见一柜黑泥，尚不能证明它属于「永加拉号」。

paragraphs.brief: 保险柜序列号确认沉船身份
sentences: That is until a photograph of the safe was circulated in the Townsville Daily Bulletin.
直到这只保险柜的照片登上《汤斯维尔日报》，事情才有了转机。
The Queensland Manager of Chubb & Sons Lock and Safe Company recognized it as a Chubb’s model.
Chubb父子锁具与保险柜公司的昆士兰地区经理认出这是自家公司生产的型号。
He sent the partial serial number seen on the safe – 9825W – to the main company in England to see if they could find a match.
他把保险箱上所见的部分序列号 9825W 发往英格兰的主要公司看看他们能否找到匹配
The safe found in the wreck matched that of a Chubb safe that had been bought for use onboard Yongala — confirming the wreck’s identity and Yongala’s final resting place.
在残骸中找到的保险箱与购买用于Yongala船上的Chubb保险箱的保险箱相符——这证实了残骸的身份和Yongala的最后休息地点。
paragraphs.gist: 保险柜的照片登报后，制造商凭部分序列号查到该柜正是为「永加拉号」订购的，终于确认沉船身份和最终位置。

paragraphs.brief: 残骸的位置、朝向与深度
sentences: Today, the wreck of the SS Yongala lies 89 kilometres southeast of Townsville.
今天，永加拉号残骸位于汤斯维尔东南八十九公里处。
The 110 metre long wreck rests on the open sandy bottom with a slight list to starboard and the bow pointing north.
长一百一十米的船体躺在开阔的沙质海床上，略向右舷倾斜，船首朝北。
The wreck starts at about 14 metres below the surface of the water and extends all the way to 28 metres at the bottom.
残骸从水面下约14米处开始，一直延伸到底部28米。
paragraphs.gist: 这艘长一百一十米的残骸位于汤斯维尔东南八十九公里的沙质海床上，船首朝北、略向右倾，横跨水下十四至二十八米的深度。

paragraphs.brief: 受保护沉船变成人工礁
sentences: The Yongala wreck is protected under the Historic Shipwrecks Act of 1976, so penetration is forbidden.
永加拉号残骸受1976年《历史沉船法》保护，禁止潜入船体内部。
Its isolation and late discovery have allowed an artificial reef to form on it, making it a magnet for marine life.
它位置偏远又发现得晚，船身逐渐成为人工礁，吸引许多海洋生物聚集。
The wreck itself is covered in colourful soft coral, hard coral and sponges and divers can expect to see thousands of tropical fish, sea snakes, sea turtles, giant trevally and Queensland gropers.
船身覆盖色彩鲜艳的软珊瑚、硬珊瑚和海绵，潜水者可望见到成千上万的热带鱼，还有海蛇、海龟、浪人鲹和昆士兰石斑鱼。
Other sightings include eagle rays, manta rays, bull sharks, whale sharks, and in the cooler months, humpback whales.
这里还见得到鹰鳐、蝠鲼、牛鲨和鲸鲨，天气较凉的月份还可能遇见座头鲸。
paragraphs.gist: 受法律保护的沉船禁止潜入内部，却已形成布满珊瑚和海绵的人工礁，周围聚集热带鱼、海龟等动物，冷季还可能见到座头鲸。

“that it might contain important documents that would lead to the identification of the ship”补足 hoping 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 hoping 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
The group had a hunch …, but had no definitive proof to back up their claims.
“that the wreck was that of the SS Yongala”修饰前面的 hunch。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
